hmda_lar.description: Every published field of the FFIEC Snapshot public LAR, 2018 onward, typed, with a decoded label next to every coded field. One row per published record.

columns.name: activity_year
columns.description: Calendar year of the final action.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Row number of the record in the published CSV (1 = first data line). Together with activity_year it identifies a record; the public LAR has no loan identifier.

columns.name: lei
columns.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the reporting institution, upper-cased.

columns.name: derived_msa_md
columns.description: MSA/MD of the property, derived by the FFIEC; 99999 means not in an MSA/MD.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-letter postal state code of the property; NULL when NA.

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: Five-digit state+county FIPS code; NULL when NA.

columns.name: census_tract
columns.description: Eleven-digit census tract (state+county+tract); NULL when NA.

columns.name: conforming_loan_limit
columns.description: Whether the loan amount is within the GSE conforming loan limit (C, NC, U = undetermined, NA). Derived by the FFIEC.

columns.name: derived_loan_product_type
columns.description: Loan type and lien status, derived by the FFIEC.

columns.name: derived_dwelling_category
columns.description: Construction method and total units, derived by the FFIEC.

columns.name: derived_ethnicity
columns.description: Applicant and co-applicant ethnicity combined, derived by the FFIEC.

columns.name: derived_race
columns.description: Applicant and co-applicant race combined, derived by the FFIEC.
allowed_values: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: derived_sex
columns.description: Applicant and co-applicant sex combined, by the FFIEC.

columns.name: action_taken
columns.description: Action taken on the application or loan.

codes.6: Purchased loan
codes.8: Preapproval request approved but not accepted

columns.name: action_taken_label
columns.description: Label for action_taken (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: purchaser_type
columns.description: Type of entity that purchased the loan.

codes.6: Commercial bank, savings bank, or savings association
codes.71: Credit union, mortgage company, or finance company

columns.name: purchaser_type_label
columns.description: Label for purchaser_type (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: preapproval
columns.description: Whether a preapproval was requested.

columns.name: preapproval_label
columns.description: Label for preapproval (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: Loan type (insurance or guarantee).

columns.name: loan_type_label
columns.description: Label for loan_type (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: loan_purpose
columns.description: Purpose of the loan.

columns.name: loan_purpose_label
columns.description: Label for loan_purpose (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: lien_status
columns.description: Lien status of the property securing the loan.

columns.name: lien_status_label
columns.description: Label for lien_status (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: reverse_mortgage
columns.description: Whether the loan is a reverse mortgage.

columns.name: reverse_mortgage_label
columns.description: Label for reverse_mortgage (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: open_end_line_of_credit
columns.description: Whether the loan is an open-end line of credit.

codes.2: Not an open-end line of credit

columns.name: open_end_line_of_credit_label
columns.description: Label for open_end_line_of_credit (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: business_or_commercial_purpose
columns.description: Whether the loan is primarily for a business or commercial purpose.

codes.1: Primarily for a business or commercial purpose
codes.2: Not primarily for a business or commercial purpose

columns.name: business_or_commercial_purpose_label
columns.description: Label for business_or_commercial_purpose (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: loan_amount
columns.description: Loan amount in US dollars. The public file reports the midpoint of the $10,000 interval containing the amount (e.g. 205000 for 200,000-209,999).

columns.name: loan_amount_na_reason
columns.description: Why loan_amount is NULL: 'NA' (not applicable) or 'Exempt' (partial exemption under EGRRCPA); NULL when a value is present.

columns.name: combined_loan_to_value_ratio
columns.description: Combined loan-to-value ratio, percent. Published as loan_to_value_ratio in the 2018 file and as combined_loan_to_value_ratio from 2019; same field.

columns.name: combined_loan_to_value_ratio_na_reason
columns.description: Why combined_loan_to_value_ratio is NULL: 'NA' (not applicable) or 'Exempt' (partial exemption under EGRRCPA); NULL when a value is present.

columns.name: interest_rate
columns.description: Interest rate, percent.

columns.name: interest_rate_na_reason
columns.description: Why interest_rate is NULL: 'NA' (not applicable) or 'Exempt' (partial exemption under EGRRCPA); NULL when a value is present.

columns.name: rate_spread
columns.description: Difference between the APR and the average prime offer rate (APOR) for a comparable transaction, percentage points. Reported for all covered originations; can be negative.

columns.name: rate_spread_na_reason
columns.description: Why rate_spread is NULL: 'NA' (not applicable) or 'Exempt' (partial exemption under EGRRCPA); NULL when a value is present.

columns.name: hoepa_status
columns.description: Whether the loan is a high-cost mortgage (HOEPA).

columns.name: hoepa_status_label
columns.description: Label for hoepa_status (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: total_loan_costs

columns.name: total_loan_costs_na_reason

hmda_lar_core.description: A common schema for every covered year (pre-2018 CFPB historic LAR and 2018+ snapshot LAR), with codes mapped to shared definitions.

columns.name: activity_year
columns.description: Calendar year of the final action.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Row number in the source file, unique within a year.

columns.name: source_era
columns.description: Which published format the row came from.

columns.name: lender_key
columns.description: Key into the lenders table: the LEI from 2018, 'agency_code-respondent_id' (the 'ARID' used by the FFIEC) before 2018.

columns.name: lei
columns.description: Legal Entity Identifier (2018+; NULL before 2018).

columns.name: respondent_id
columns.description: Pre-2018 respondent identifier (10 characters).

columns.name: agency_code
columns.description: Supervisory agency of the reporter. Pre-2018 from the LAR; 2018+ from the Transmittal Sheet.

codes.1: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
codes.7: Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

columns.name: agency_code_label
columns.description: Label for agency_code (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: Loan type. Same codes in both eras.

columns.name: loan_type_label
columns.description: Label for loan_type (NULL when the code is not in the code list).

columns.name: property_type
